text:
Olivia: Good morning — quick release-train update for this week. Please read and ack. TL;DR: release freeze starts Fri 09:00 UTC, canary rolling for v3.2.1 continues, one high-priority blocker on embeddings perf. Full notes below.

Olivia: Freeze window details: 2025-09-30 09:00 UTC -> 2025-10-02 09:00 UTC. Only emergency fixes (prod incidents) allowed. If you need an exception, tag @Olivia with the PR and risk assessment. :no_entry_sign:

Olivia: Changelog highlights (prod):
- Serving runtime: reduced memory spikes for long context (PR #4823).
- Routing: added capacity-aware fallback rule for Dedicated (config opt-in).
- Console: added per-model cold-start metric to the model dashboard.
- Optimize: new batching suggestion heuristic for chat-heavy workloads (experimental).

Olivia: Canary status: v3.2.1 deployed to canary pool (10% traffic). 18h in, error rate at 0.2% vs baseline 0.15% (still within SLO but elevated). Latency p95 +12ms on 2048 token sequences.

Alex: Acked. I finished the canary smoke scripts last night and reran them at 03:20 UTC. Logs showed one retry spike around 02:45.

release-bot: Canary health check summary: 2025-09-29 23:00 UTC -> 2025-09-30 17:00 UTC.
- requests: 1,024,832
- errors: 2,506 (0.244%)
- p95 latency: 196ms (baseline 184ms)

Priya: Noted. The embeddings perf regression is from quantized-ops on A100s in Dedicated. I'm bisecting and have a repro job running against the ded-qa pool. Will report within 3h.

Marco: If embeddings issue holds up, we should consider auto-fallback to float-16 variant for Dedicated customers that have strict latency SLOs. We have the fallback policy queued in the router but it's not enabled for this model.

Jenna: Can we get an ETA on whether the fix will be in time for Monday's batch rollout? Product is pushing the customer-facing changelog.

Priya: If the bisect points to quantization, a patch will be small (config toggles + a kernel patch). Optimistically 6-12h, realistically 24h including QA. I'll flag if we need to block the rollout.

Olivia: Action items: 
- Priya: update with root-cause within 3h (assigned)
- Marco: enable router fallback policy for model-x on Dedicated as a temporary mitigation if perf doesn't improve (opt-in)
- Alex: keep smoke scripts running and post anomalies to this thread
- Jenna: hold off on publishing customer changelog until Monday if the embedding story changes

Olivia: Emergency contact flow reminder: if you hit a production incident during freeze, ping #eng-oncall and start an incident doc. If it's related to this canary, @Olivia and @Marco will triage first.

Alex: Quick note on rollout tooling: I pushed a small change to the rollout dashboard that surfaces canary vs baseline comparison for p50/p95. Use the `?compare=canary` query param.

Marco: Regarding rollback thresholds — current policy: 0.5% absolute error increase OR p95 +30ms. We should revisit these numbers in next week's release-retrospective; they were set during heavy-load tests.

Jenna: acked. I'll keep the customer comms in draft and will wait for final sign-off Monday morning.

Priya: Update: bisect found a kernel mismatch in the quantized matmul on A100 driver 535.x. Repro job link: https://ci.internal/repro/1754000000 (will attach logs to the issue). Moving to a temporary driver-compat shim in the runtime to validate.

Olivia: Thanks — if the shim verifies, we can roll it to canary and see if errors drop below 0.18%. If not, we'll flip fallback and extend canary window.

release-bot: Deployed patch candidate: runtime/shim-quant-fix@canary. CI: 92% green (some flaky tests).

Alex: Observability note — I see reduced retry spikes after the shim deploy. p95 down to 188ms in the last 30m.

Priya: Confirming: errors now 0.16%. Continuing monitoring. If stable for 2h we'll expand to 25% traffic.

Olivia: Thanks team. Please keep this thread updated. We'll do a quick sync at 15:30 UTC if there are still open items. :shipit: 

Marco: Will attend the 15:30 sync.

Jenna: I'll be there and will finalize comms if all green.
